scope_limit: PDF71/printed69 explicitly limits approval to numbered grey pages. It prints the adoption/approval dates, with typed names and no visible handwritten signatures. The twelve identified map pages are white-background illustrations, not covered by that blanket grey-page approval. Do not treat map colours or hatched sectors as approved current development rights. Municipal Pully2040 page dated 2March2026 calls this linked1996 PDF current while revision is underway; later detailed planning and parcel-level rights remain unassessed. PDF27 includes cantonal transport qualification; council amendments are incorporated on PDF13/21/22/59.
